readings: Compute the HGB/HCT ratio for every individual laboratory test record (each Laboratory row, ignoring rows where HGB or HCT is null or HCT is 0). Let A be the average ratio across all of these records. Keep the records whose ratio is above A, and for each compute diff_A = ratio - A. Let B be the average ratio within this kept group. Keep only the records whose ratio is above B, and for each compute diff_B = ratio - B. Return one row with the average ratio, the average diff_A, and the average diff_B over these final records, unrounded.

Compute each patient's single HGB/HCT ratio as the average of HGB/HCT over all of that patient's laboratory test records (ignoring rows where HGB or HCT is null or HCT is 0). Let A be the average of these patient-level ratios across all patients. Keep the patients whose ratio is above A, and for each compute diff_A = ratio - A. Let B be the average patient-level ratio within this kept group. Keep only the patients whose ratio is above B, and for each compute diff_B = ratio - B. Return one row with the average ratio, the average diff_A, and the average diff_B over these final patients, unrounded.

Compute each patient's single HGB/HCT ratio as the patient's average HGB divided by the patient's average HCT over all of that patient's laboratory test records (ignoring null values). Let A be the average of these patient-level ratios across all patients. Keep the patients whose ratio is above A, and for each compute diff_A = ratio - A. Let B be the average patient-level ratio within this kept group. Keep only the patients whose ratio is above B, and for each compute diff_B = ratio - B. Return one row with the average ratio, the average diff_A, and the average diff_B over these final patients, unrounded.
queries:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT CAST(HGB AS REAL) / HCT AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_a FROM r
),
ka AS (
  SELECT r.ratio, r.ratio - a.avg_a AS diff_a
  FROM r, a
  WHERE r.ratio > a.avg_a
),
b AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_b FROM ka
),
kb AS (
  SELECT ka.ratio, ka.diff_a, ka.ratio - b.avg_b AS diff_b
  FROM ka, b
  WHERE ka.ratio > b.avg_b
)
SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff_a) AS avg_diff_A, AVG(diff_b) AS avg_diff_B
FROM kb;
WITH p AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB * 1.0 / HCT) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT != 0
    GROUP BY ID
),
a AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS A FROM p
),
k AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - a.A AS diff_A
    FROM p, a
    WHERE p.ratio > a.A
),
b AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS B FROM k
),
f AS (
    SELECT k.ID, k.ratio, k.diff_A, k.ratio - b.B AS diff_B
    FROM k, b
    WHERE k.ratio > b.B
)
SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff_A) AS avg_diff_A, AVG(diff_B) AS avg_diff_B
FROM f;
WITH r AS (
  SELECT AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / AVG(HCT) AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
  HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) <> 0
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS A FROM r
),
k1 AS (
  SELECT r.ratio, r.ratio - a.A AS diff_A
  FROM r, a
  WHERE r.ratio > a.A
),
b AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS B FROM k1
),
k2 AS (
  SELECT k1.ratio, k1.diff_A, k1.ratio - b.B AS diff_B
  FROM k1, b
  WHERE k1.ratio > b.B
)
SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff_A) AS avg_diff_A, AVG(diff_B) AS avg_diff_B
FROM k2;
